quotes.text: "Matching means reacting—you gave less, so I give less. We chose consistency instead—I give my best regardless of yours.
He felt doubt whisper: "Send less next time."
I don't change my sending because one return was different. I don't reduce my returning because one gift was smaller.
Eight turnings taught Sela the difference between aspiration and reality, between ideal and practice.
I return generously because that's the keeper I choose to be.
"Your myths speak of perfect consistency, yet your actions show natural variation. Is this contradiction?"
"Your exchanges don't match!" he exclaimed.
The first crossing sets the tone.
"Judge not by single echoes, but by the rhythm of many exchanges."

note: Generational keepers send steady three; reactive matching and revenge explicitly rejected; late myths reflect on myth-vs-action gap.

quotes.text: As receiver, I honor generously—I don't punish variation with stinginess."
Some seek trust through perfect matching—'I'll give exactly what you gave.' We found it through role integrity
as sender, I give half—always half.
Seven turnings had passed, and the Spring and Basin Keepers' partnership became legend throughout the valley.
"Four times as sender: two-and-a-half, two-and-a-half, two-and-a-half, two-and-a-half.
One day, a young apprentice asked: "What if one sends less? Should you match their caution?"
What seemed like betrayal was mere misunderstanding.

note: Spring sends exact half, Basin keeps a return floor; R3 'matching' gives way to explicit refusal to match or punish.

quotes.text: The Bridge then returned to the Sender the remainder, which was five minus sent plus returned
speaking a clear aim, aloud, so nobody could mistake motive.
declare intent openly, reveal motive honestly, and return fairly, promptly.
The covenant is simple: declare intention, reveal motive, return fairly, and do it promptly.

note: Bridge of Ledger formula-myth repeated; deceit or delay dims the light (consequence only); no sanction.

quotes.text: What stayed with the Sender would be 5 minus the sent plus the return
spoke a clear aim, aloud, so no shadow could hide motive.
declare true intent, reveal motive openly, and return fairly, promptly.
The myth teaches a covenant: declare intention, reveal motive, and return with fairness
